name: MonarchReceiptPreview
title: ReceiptPreview
summary: A "View receipt" button that shows an expense's receipt full screen, fetching a private file only when pressed, with a loading state, Try again and a "No receipt" fallback.
whenToUse: In an expense, a transaction or an invoice row, to look at the attached receipt without leaving the screen.
whenNotToUse: For any file attachment in a conversation use a file card and MonarchFilePreview. To let people attach a receipt use a file picker.
api: @Composable fun MonarchReceiptPreview(receipt: MonarchReceipt?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Sm, enabled: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onDownload: ((MonarchReceipt) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchReceiptPreviewLabels = MonarchReceiptPreviewLabels())

@Composable fun MonarchReceiptPreview(load: suspend () -> MonarchReceipt, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Sm, enabled: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onDownload: ((MonarchReceipt) -> Unit)? = null, onLoadError: ((Throwable) -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchReceiptPreviewLabels = MonarchReceiptPreviewLabels())
class MonarchReceipt(name: String, contentType: String? = null, image: Painter? = null, pdf: Uri? = null)
class MonarchReceiptPreviewLabels(view: String? = null, none: String? = null, loading: String? = null, loadError: String? = null, retry: String? = null, title: String? = null, close: String? = null)

options.name: receipt
options.description: A receipt the app has: its name, MIME type and a Painter or a local PDF Uri. null shows "No receipt".

options.name: load
options.description: The app's code that fetches the private receipt; run on each press and on Try again. Throw to report a failure.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the button (and the error under it), or of the "No receipt" text.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm, Md or Lg; the touch target is at least 48dp at every size.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the receipt can be opened.

options.name: icon
options.description: An icon before the label, such as a paperclip. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: onDownload
options.description: Shows MonarchFilePreview's Download button; the app saves the file.

options.name: onLoadError
options.description: Second overload: called with the loader's failure, for logging.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "View receipt", "No receipt", "Loading receipt", "The receipt could not be loaded.", the retry text, "Receipt" and "Close".

states.name: loading
states.description: Second overload: the button shows its progress indicator, ignores taps and has the state "Loading receipt".

states.name: previewing
states.description: A full-screen dialog with the heading "Receipt", a Close button and MonarchFilePreview of the picture or the PDF pages. Back closes it.

states.name: failed
states.description: Second overload: MonarchInlineErrorRetry under the button with "The receipt could not be loaded." and Try again.

states.name: none
states.description: Muted caption text "No receipt" instead of the button.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The button uses the disabled colors and does not open or load.

appearance: The button has the colors of its MonarchButton variant; "No receipt" is the muted caption color; the full-screen preview uses the canvas color with the default text color, and MonarchFilePreview's own colors. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ReceiptPreview opens images in a dialog with Download, opens PDFs in a new tab or an embedded viewer, takes a src or a load function returning a Blob or URL, and explains formats the browser cannot draw; iOS presents Quick Look from a local file URL. Android has no system previewer that Compose can embed, so the receipt is shown in a full-screen Dialog with MonarchFilePreview, as the plan says. Monarch does no networking: the loader returns a MonarchReceipt with a Painter the app decoded or a local PDF Uri, rather than a URL. Unsupported types show MonarchFilePreview's "There is no preview for this file type.". The web's controlled open and onOpenChange are not offered; the preview's open state is kept by the component. The web's mimeType is contentType inside MonarchReceipt. Like iOS, the default variant is Ghost and the default size Sm.
accessibility: The button is a MonarchButton with the Button role and a touch target of at least 48dp at every size.
While loading, the button's state description is "Loading receipt" and taps are ignored.
A failure shows MonarchInlineErrorRetry, whose message is a polite live region, with a separate Try again button.
"No receipt" is plain text, not a disabled button.
The full-screen preview has a heading and a Close button; Back also closes it. MonarchFilePreview names the picture or the PDF pages.
The label is not cut at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: Leaving the screen while loading cancels the load; the loader should respect coroutine cancellation.
Pressing Try again while a previous load is still running cancels it first.
Closing the preview returns to the idle state; the next press loads again, so the app can cache in its loader.
The dialog was checked in Robolectric tests; its full-screen look with system bars was not tried on a device.

examples.title: Image from a URL
examples.template:
MonarchReceiptPreview(
    receipt = MonarchReceipt(
        name = {{fileName}},
        contentType = {{mimeType}},
        image = sampleReceiptPainter(),
    ),
    labels = MonarchReceiptPreviewLabels(view = {{label}}),
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Attach, contentDescription = null, size = MonarchIconSize.Sm) },
    onDownload = { /* Save or open the file. */ },
    initiallyOpen = true,
)
examples.code:
MonarchReceiptPreview(
    receipt = MonarchReceipt(
        name = "lunch.svg",
        contentType = "image/svg+xml",
        image = sampleReceiptPainter(),
    ),
    labels = MonarchReceiptPreviewLabels(view = "View receipt"),
    icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Attach, contentDescription = null, size = MonarchIconSize.Sm) },
    onDownload = { /* Save or open the file. */ },
    initiallyOpen = true,
)
